g.text: Drawer: the same scene receives different DINOv2 costs
Actual DINOv2 ViT-S/14 features; 16×16 patches, mean squared difference over 384 features. ImageNet normalization.
This is a cost-contribution map, not attention or causal saliency. Coordinates are image pixels; α term excluded. Episode 002.
